parts.problem_md:
The number of attempts at a driving test and the number of driving lessons for each of 17 people are shown in the scatter diagram.

![q6b-058032-octnov2018-cie-igcse-maths-core](assets/023-q6b-058032-octnov2018-cie-igcse-maths-core.png)

i) What type of correlation is shown in the scatter diagram?

[1]

ii) One of these people is picked at random. Work out the probability that this person had 5 or more attempts.

[1]

iii) Draw a line of best fit on the scatter diagram.

[1]

iv) Another person had 15 lessons. Estimate their number of attempts.

[1]
parts.solution_md:
i) *The points form a pattern that starts in the top left of the graph and go down towards the bottom right*

**Negative correlation**** ****[1]**

ii) *The probability that a person picked at random had 5 attempts or more to pass can be found by dividing the number of people who took 5 or more attempts by the total number of people*

> *10 people out of the 17 people took 5 or more attempts to pass*

$\frac{10}{17}$ **[1]**

iii) *Draw a straight line starting in the top left and going down towards the bottom right* *There should be the same number of points either side of the line*

![5xv8wJFA_scatter-graph-with-line-of-best-fit](assets/024-5xv8wjfa-scatter-graph-with-line-of-best-fit.png)

**[1]**

iv) *Draw a vertical line up from 15 on the **x**-axis until it meets the line of best fit* *Draw a horizontal line across from this point until it meets the **y**-axis*

![scatter-graph-using-line-of-best-fit-for-prediction](assets/025-scatter-graph-using-line-of-best-fit-for-predict.png)

> *Read off the value from the **y**-axis, the line lies between 5 and 6*

> *It must be a whole number of lessons so choose the value it is closest to *

**6**** ****[1]**

> *An answer of 5 will also be accepted*

parts.problem_md:
The table shows the maximum power, kW, and the time taken, in seconds, to accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h for each of 10 cars.

| Maximum power (kW) | 77 | 52 | 103 | 55 | 44 | 51 | 85 | 135 | 90 | 110 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Time (seconds) | 12.5 | 14.9 | 9.0 | 12.1 | 14.4 | 12.9 | 10.0 | 7.1 | 11.0 | 9.4 |

i) Find the range of the times.

........................................... s [1]

ii) Find the median maximum power.

........................................... kW [2]
parts.solution_md:
(i) *Range = highest time (14.9 seconds) - lowest time (7.1 seconds) *

> $14.9-7.1=7.8$* *

**7.8 seconds** **[1]**

(ii) *Order the maximum power values. *

$44,51,52,55,77,85,90,103,110,135$

* ***[1]**

> *Median = middle value. *

$\cancel{44} , \cancel{51} , \cancel{52} , \cancel{55} , 77 , 85 , \cancel{90} , \cancel{103} , \cancel{110} , \cancel{135}$

> *The middle value is halfway between 77 and 85. Add together the two numbers and divide by 2. *

> $( 77 + 85 ) \div 2 = 81$* *

**81 kW ****[1]**
